To assess the prevalence of short sleep duration among workers, CDC analyzed data from the 2010 National Health Interview Survey (NHIS).

methods_quotes.q: Weighted data were used to produce national estimates of short sleep duration by industry of employment and usual shift worked.
Point estimates and estimates of corresponding variances were calculated using statistical software to account for the complex sample design.
Statistical significance was defined as p<0.05.
Results based on fewer than 10 workers are not shown because of the instability of these estimates.
